title: Scully meets a scientist in the Mojave

tellings.quote: They met in the Mojave Desert with one of them and he starts to tell Frank this amazing story about a flying saucer recovery.

plain: Around 1949, the writer Frank Scully is said to have met a man in the Mojave Desert who told him "this amazing story about a flying saucer recovery", meaning a crashed saucer picked up by the authorities. Scott Ramsey tells it on the show without naming a source. He links the meeting to two men, Silas Newton and Leo Gaybower, and to Scully's book Behind the Flying Saucers.
